CMKPipeCreateImage.description: Central entry point for Text2Image and Inpaint: selects the task and prepares image, mask, prompts, and the complete PROCESS for the remaining flow.
features: MODE dropdown for Text2Image and Inpaint with a dynamic interface
Guided inpaint tasks: Replace Object, Remove Object, Extend Image, and Custom
Diagnostic shows the source image and the actual mask fill passed downstream
CMKPipeCreateImage.placementNote: Place as the central starting module before optional ControlNet or the first KSampler. Connect IMAGE and MASK for Inpaint; Remove Object only requires the mask.

CMKCheckpointVAELoaderPipe.description: Selects the image model and matching image decoder.
features: Provides the model for a sampler or refiner
CMKCheckpointVAELoaderPipe.placementNote: Place before the KSampler or Refiner and connect MODEL to its MODEL input.

CMKLoadImage.description: Loads an image into the flow without modifying it.
features: Compact image loader without resizing
CMKLoadImage.placementNote: Place before a module that processes an existing image.

CMKImageLoadAndResizePipe.description: Loads an image and optionally adjusts it to the working size.
features: Load an image
Prepare size and orientation for the flow
CMKImageLoadAndResizePipe.placementNote: Place at the beginning of an image-based flow before Create Image or a processing module.

CMKSwapImageLoaderPipe.description: Loads target and source images for FaceSwap.
features: Prepares both required images together

CMKControlNetPreparePipe.description: Optionally adds image guidance for the following generation step.
features: Uses composition or contours of an image as guidance
CMKControlNetPreparePipe.placementNote: Place between Create Image and the first KSampler. Omit it when no image guidance is needed.

CMKZITControlNetPreparePipe.description: Optionally adds Canny image guidance for ZIT.
features: Uses image contours as structural guidance for ZIT
CMKZITControlNetPreparePipe.placementNote: Place between Create Image and the ZIT KSampler. Omit it when no image guidance is needed.

CMKFamilyResultMergePipe.description: Merges parallel SDXL and ZIT family branches according to the active model family selected in 01.
features: Selects only the active family branch
Keeps the inactive branch from executing
Provides a family-neutral result for FaceSwap or 90
CMKFamilyResultMergePipe.placementNote: Use only when SDXL and ZIT are built in parallel in the same workflow. Place after the last SDXL-only module (10, 20, 25, or 30) and the ZIT KSampler, then continue with shared module 40 or 90.

CMK_SaveProjectImage.description: Saves the finished image with a project name and optional date folder.
features: Saves the result at the end of processing
CMK_SaveProjectImage.placementNote: Place after the desired image processing as the final module.

CMK Flow · 02 SDXL LoRA Stack.description: Combines multiple LoRAs into a clear stack for the following flow.
features: Build a LoRA stack
Weight multiple LoRAs
Prepare the prompt for the flow
CMK Flow · 02 SDXL LoRA Stack.placementNote: Place before Create Image when one or more LoRAs are used.

CMK Flow · 10 KSampler SDXL 1st Pass.description: Creates the first image pass from the prepared CMK process.

features.title: Run the first sampling pass
features.description: Runs the first image pass from the prepared CMK PROCESS.

features.title: Control CFG and scheduler
features.description: Applies CFG, scheduler, and additional sampler parameters.

features.title: Seed management
features.description: Manages and reproduces the seed for consistent results.

features.title: Process prompt and conditioning
features.description: Processes the prompt, negative prompt, and conditioning.

features.title: LoRA integration
features.description: Integrates LoRAs seamlessly into the sampling process.

CMK Flow · 10 KSampler SDXL 1st Pass.placementNote: Place after Create Image and optional ControlNet. Connect the selected model to MODEL.
CMK Flow · 10 KSampler SDXL 1st Pass.dependencyNote: Connect SAMPLED to the Refiner input with the same name.

featureCallout.title: Supports both Text2Image and Inpaint
featureCallout.text: A single sampler module for both processes – works with any compatible SDXL checkpoint. No specialized checkpoints required.

CMK Flow · 10 KSampler Z-Image Turbo.description: Loads ZIT through native ComfyUI nodes, prepares conditioning, samples the image, and decodes it into the shared CMK image flow.
features: Native ZIT model loading
Eight-step Turbo sampling
Direct IMAGE output for shared post-processing
CMK Flow · 10 KSampler Z-Image Turbo.placementNote: Place after 01 or the optional ZIT ControlNet. Continue with optional 35 when both model families are present, or connect directly to 40 FaceSwap or 90 Upscale & Save.

CMK Flow · 20 Refiner SDXL.description: Refines the first pass in a separate refinement step.
features: Run a separate refinement pass
Use the sampling result
Apply Refiner conditioning
CMK Flow · 20 Refiner SDXL.placementNote: Place directly after 10 KSampler SDXL 1st Pass. Continue with 25 Detailer SDXL, 30 FaceProcess SDXL, optional 35, 40 FaceSwap, or 90 Upscale & Save.
CMK Flow · 20 Refiner SDXL.dependencyNote: SAMPLED, MODEL, and PROCESS come from the corresponding outputs of the preceding modules.

CMK Flow · 25 Detailer SDXL.description: Adds a curated detailer step for targeted image enhancement.
features: Enhance a selected image area
Enable or skip the module centrally
Return the result directly to CMK Flow
CMK Flow · 25 Detailer SDXL.placementNote: Use only in the SDXL branch. Place after KSampler or Refiner and before 30 FaceProcess SDXL, optional 35, 40 FaceSwap, or 90 Upscale & Save.

CMK Flow · 25 Detailer SDXL · Advanced.description: Combines two separately configured Detailer branches and returns their processed areas to the flow.
features: Configure two Detailer branches independently
Merge processed image areas
Use one shared log and final flow boundary
CMK Flow · 25 Detailer SDXL · Advanced.placementNote: Use only in the SDXL branch. Place after KSampler or Refiner and before 30 FaceProcess SDXL, optional 35, 40 FaceSwap, or 90 Upscale & Save.
CMK Flow · 25 Detailer SDXL · Advanced.dependencyNote: Each branch needs a suitable detector model for its intended image area.

CMK Flow · 40 FaceSwap.description: Runs FaceSwap inside the CMK Flow pipeline.
features: FaceSwap within the flow pipeline
Process the target image
Enable or skip the module centrally
CMK Flow · 40 FaceSwap.placementNote: Shared family-neutral module. Place after the final SDXL or ZIT result, or after optional 35, and before 90 Upscale & Save.

CMK Flow · 40 FaceSwap · Advanced.description: Processes up to three target persons in separate FaceSwap branches and returns the combined result to the flow.
features: Three branches for left, center, and right target persons
Merge processed image areas
Use one shared log and final flow boundary
CMK Flow · 40 FaceSwap · Advanced.placementNote: Shared family-neutral module. Place after the final SDXL or ZIT result, or after optional 35, and before 90 Upscale & Save.
CMK Flow · 40 FaceSwap · Advanced.dependencyNote: Select a separate source image for every FaceSwap branch in use.

CMK Flow · 30 FaceProcess SDXL.description: Prepares a detected face for further processing in the flow.
features: Process one selected face
Enable or skip the module centrally
Return the result directly to CMK Flow
CMK Flow · 30 FaceProcess SDXL.placementNote: Use only in the SDXL branch. Place after 20 Refiner SDXL or 25 Detailer SDXL and before optional 35, 40 FaceSwap, or 90 Upscale & Save.

CMK Flow · 30 FaceProcess SDXL · Advance.description: Processes up to three target persons in separate FaceProcess branches and returns the combined result to the flow.
features: Configure up to three FaceProcess branches independently
Merge processed face areas
Use one shared log and final flow boundary
CMK Flow · 30 FaceProcess SDXL · Advance.placementNote: Use only in the SDXL branch. Place after 20 Refiner SDXL or 25 Detailer SDXL and before optional 35, 40 FaceSwap, or 90 Upscale & Save.
CMK Flow · 30 FaceProcess SDXL · Advance.dependencyNote: Each branch independently selects its target face and processing mode.

CMK Flow · 90 Upscale & Save.description: Upscales the finished image and provides the saving finish of CMK Flow.
features: Upscale the output image
Control filename and destination folder
Save the image as the final flow step
CMK Flow · 90 Upscale & Save.placementNote: Shared family-neutral finish. Place after the final SDXL or ZIT result, optional 35, or 40 FaceSwap.

toolbox.CMKDiagnosticConcat: Appends up to 32 complete CMK diagnostics in input order for Preview Render, Summary, or Preview Board.
toolbox.CMKPreviewBoard: Combines up to 32 CMK diagnostics into one visual overview and places multiple processing stages directly beside each other.
toolbox.CMKPreviewRender: Turns one CMK diagnostic into a complete visual process view with intermediate images, captions, and the decisive settings.
toolbox.CMKSummary: Condenses a CMK diagnostic into a clear summary of the processing performed, its settings, and its result.
toolbox.CMKLogCreate: Creates an empty CMK log pipe for structured workflow messages.
toolbox.CMKLogSetBlock: Adds a named and sortable text block to a CMK log pipe.
toolbox.CMKLogConcat: Combines up to 32 log blocks in an existing CMK log pipe.
toolbox.CMKLogExportText: Sorts a CMK log pipe and exports its complete content as readable text.
toolbox.CMK_ImageMetrics: Reads image dimensions, batch size, and channels and also provides them as a CMK diagnostic.
toolbox.CMK_ImageQuickMetrics: Shows key image and tensor values directly in the node and passes the image through unchanged.
